verdicts.detail: correctly failed on selftest/bad_configs.py:quarter_thickness (same bracket at 1/4 thickness; deflection goes as 1/t^3 so this is ~64x worse and nothing else about the part changes): 44.781 mm at 15 N (limit 0.5 mm)

correctly failed on selftest/bad_configs.py:overloaded (same bracket at 20x load; stress is linear in load so this lands far past yield while the geometry is untouched): 73.5 MPa vs 15.0 MPa allowable (util 4.90, petg)

correctly failed on selftest/bad_configs.py:stubby (a short, deep arm (L/h below 5) where shear deflection stops being negligible and the other structural gates quietly become optimistic): slenderness 2.5 (>= 5.0 for Euler-Bernoulli; below this the deflection gate under-predicts)
correctly failed on selftest/bad_configs.py:oversized (the same bracket with a 400 mm arm: nothing wrong but the footprint): 414 x 30 x 7 mm vs 204 mm usable (220 bed - 2x8 brim)

correctly failed on selftest/bad_configs.py:fat_nozzle (the same part on a 1.2 mm nozzle, where 3 perimeters no longer fit in the section — the geometry is untouched and the process is wrong): thinnest section 3.0 mm vs 3.6 mm minimum (3 perimeters at a 1.2 mm nozzle)
